definitions.full: H507. Eleph III. אֶ֫לֶף proper name, of a location city in Benjamin, ׳הָא Josh 18:28 ; perhaps Lifta northwest from Jerusalem Survey iii. 18 (compare II. אֶלֶף 2 for probably meaning).

occurrences.englishText: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
